caption: The drawing depicts a hammer with a long, light brown, wood-textured handle that tapers slightly towards the end. The hammer's head is metallic, primarily dark gray, and consists of two parts: a cylindrical, flat-faced pounding surface on one end and a sharply pointed, chisel-like claw on the opposite side, both attached horizontally to the handle. The overall composition is centered, with the hammer angled diagonally from the lower right to the upper left. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a faint, lightly sketched outline of the same hammer. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color. Handwritten text appears below the hammer.
title: Wrought Iron Hammer
